items: 4G LTE cellular security camera with solar panel (sold as one product or bundle)
why: ChatGPT recommended four cameras that each come with solar charging, including a carded Reolink Go Series G440 Solar Bundle. The only extra it named is the monthly cellular data plan, which is a service and not a cart item. What decides the right pick is carrier and band compatibility (for example, the ANRAN supports only AT&T and T-Mobile) and whether there is enough sunlight for the battery. That makes this a single-product comparison of cameras such as the Arenti GO3G and AnywhereCam Eagle 4G Pro, not a kit.
